additional_info.body:
Hello Lorenz,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0378393 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
BE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Yes
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Yes
Performance monitoring by RC
Please note that during the analysis of the charger and error flags, it was observed that the LEM is experiencing an issue. Among the LEM error flags, the critical error flag detected is "Tampering Detected." This indicates that unauthorized manipulation may have occurred. To address this, please inspect the device's integrity, including the manufacturer seals, front panel of the Meter Unit, and Meter Unit housing for signs of forced opening. In both scenarios, it is necessary to replace both components of the LEM, namely the Sensing Unit and Metering Unit. Below are the part numbers for your reference to order and carry out the replacement activity.
Outlet 2: outoforder, LEMState: Error Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1212390857 status: {"value":25,"bits":{"suLinkStatusIsOk":true,"muFatalErrorOccured":false,"transactionIsOnGoing":false,"tamperingIsDetected":true,"timeSyncStatusIsOk":true,"overTemperatureIsDetected":false,"reversedVoltage":false,"suMeasureFailureOccurred":false}}, error: {"value":0,"bits":{"muInitIsFailed":false,"suStateIsInvalid":false,"versionCheckIsFailed":false,"muRngInitIsFailed":false,"muDataIntegrityIsFailed":false,"muFwIntegrityIsFailed":false,"suIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIsFull":false,"memoryAccessIsFailed":false,"muStateIsFailed":false}})
Before proceeding, please verify the current LEM rating as the charger configuration is not linked to the SCB, and the faulty outlet has a rating of 500A. Consequently, place the order based on the highlighted part numbers, considering that the charger is non-ERK.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
BE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
